summary: Use the pinned shared developer bar, meters and build identity utilities in Fractal web, retaining the recent-changes disclosure and provisioning member sources consistently in CI.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of persisted application state.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol or persisted-state compatibility change. Development and performance builds use a shared diagnostics shell; production builds retain the existing diagnostics loading boundary. Recent changes remain available from the developer bar.

manual.detail: No upgrade action for installed applications. Source checkouts use the documented member bootstrap and web shell to materialize the pinned diagnostics dependencies.

recovery.detail: No data migration or rollback recovery is required.
